List.lookup.eq_def.states: ∀ {α : Type u} {β : Type v} [inst : BEq α] (x : α) (x_1 : List (α × β)), List.lookup x x_1 = match x, x_1 with | x, [] => none | a, (k, b) :: as => match a == k with | true => some b | false => List.lookup a as

Gen.sha256_idOf_eq_idText.states: ∀ (env : Loops.Env) (commit : String), Loops.idOf Gen.sha256 env commit = Loops.idText ⟨List.foldl (fun a b => 256 * a + b.toNat) 0 (Gen.sha256 (Loops.utf8 (Loops.idPreimage env commit))), ⋯⟩

Gen.sha256_bounded.states: ∀ (msg : List UInt8), List.foldl (fun a b => 256 * a + b.toNat) 0 (Gen.sha256 msg) < 256 ^ 32

Gen.Read.recordId_bounded.states: ∀ {path : String} {j : Loops.Json} {n : Loops.RecordId}, Gen.Read.recordId path j = Except.ok n → ↑n < 256 ^ 32
